name: assembly-newsh2-3
summary: A long industrial pipe lying on the ground, 216 x 28 px, built from nine 2x2 pieces: a rounded grey end cap and a big red end clamp on the left, seven identical sections (grey can, red clamp collar, grey can, thin red coupling, grey can, thin red coupling) and a grey cone tapering to a point on the right. Round parts throughout (cans, collars, couplings, cone): each is a cylinder about as tall as it is wide, lit on top and shaded on the screen-bottom side; the couplings rest on dark saddles. Hard, crisp rims where cans meet collars and couplings.

traits: grey cylinder segments 12 px across (rows 7-18), round: about 12 px tall, not a squashed capsule
short chamfered rims at both ends (darker end columns), crisp rather than blobby
one mid grey; the sprite's dark lower half is shadow, left to the lighting
three per section, all the same diameter
features.note: The body of the pipe. Box: the middle can of the first repeating section (columns 24-47).

traits: red collar wider than the cans: 14 px across (rows 6-19), round
crisp lit rim on its left edge (the bright column), flat-sided disc, not a ball
mid red, one per section
features.note: The big red flange/clamp of each section.

traits: dark band (rows 15-17, open at row 16) cut into the lower side of each red collar, with a lit red lip below it (row 18)
cut in, not painted on
features.note: Reads in the enlarged sprite as an L-shaped red bracket under each collar: the split of the clamp.

traits: thin red rod about 5 px across (rows 9-13), round, constant diameter
visibly narrower than the cans, so the pipe pinches in between cans
two per section (columns 12-14 and 20-22 of the section)
dark brown block under each coupling (row 15-16), standing on the ground up to the coupling
matte, darker than the pipe
features.note: Supports the thin couplings rest on.

traits: grey can with a rounded, domed left end, same 12 px diameter as the cans
followed by a thin red coupling and a short can
the biggest red collar, 16 px across (rows 5-20), round
same dark slot and lit lip on its lower side as the section collars
features.note: Big red end flange at the right edge of newsh2-1.

traits: grey cone tapering from the can diameter to a point at column 212
round in section, height following the width
smooth, slightly shiny metal
